C0477.title: Foshan Man’s Credit Card Compromised Abroad After Clicking Fake Bank Points Redemption Link
C0477.summary: A Foshan resident, Mr. Chen, received a text message from a number starting with '95***' claiming his bank credit card points were about to expire. After clicking the attached 'points redemption' link and entering his card number, expiry date, and CVV code, his card was subsequently used for unauthorized overseas transactions. The case illustrates a typical phishing scheme using fake points redemp
